# Association of British Theatre Technicians (ABTT)

> > The Association of British Theatre Technicians (ABTT) is the UK's leading professional body for theatre technicians, promoting technical excellence, sustainability, accessibility, and industry standards across the performing arts sector.

ABTT works closely with organizations including UK Theatre, Theatres Trust, SOLT, and ESTA to support technical theatre professionals through advocacy, guidance, events like the ABTT Theatre Show, and industry campaigns such as #WeMakeEvents. The organization champions sustainability initiatives, disability inclusion through the Seven Inclusive Principles, and provides critical support during industry challenges.

## Key Topics

- Theatre technical standards and best practices
- Sustainability in theatre and circular economy
- Disability inclusion and accessibility (Seven Inclusive Principles)
- Entertainment technology and ESTA standards
- #WeMakeEvents industry support campaign
- COVID-19 guidance and impact on theatre sector
- Brexit and EU touring regulations
- ABTT Theatre Show and industry events
- Freelancer workforce conditions
- Theatre Trust partnership
- UK Theatre and SOLT collaboration
- Industry advocacy and member support
- Inclusive recovery and accessibility initiatives
